comment: The tools setup downloads, each at one exact version, checked by size and SHA-256 (fetch.py). An entry whose sha256 is null is not pinned yet and fetch.py refuses it. Sizes are the publishers'; each sum was measured on a first download and checked against the publisher's own checksum where it lists one.
